description: UNOFFICIAL fork of ModernUI-MC to add minor version update support.

mods.name: Modern UI
mods.description:
Modern desktop framework from low-level 3D graphics API to high-level view model, for development of 2D/3D rendering software or game engine, with internationalization support and many new technologies.
    Modern UI is a desktop application framework designed for standalone 2D and 3D rendering software development. It makes use of modern 3D graphical APIs and technologies to provide high real-time rendering performance. For good measure, Modern UI improves and optimizes a set of features used by Android and its own set of internationalization supporting text layout engine meeting Unicode specification.
    This version is an official version that extends to Minecraft and Fabric, which combines Modern UI with Minecraft and provides a large number of additional features and modding APIs.

releases.notes:
### Modern UI 3.12.0.5-build.4 — Version bump (2026-01-29)
* Performance: use async PBO readback for UI screenshots; cap `GLFontAtlas` growth and evict chunks; index glyphs by chunk for atlas eviction.
* UX/input: discard stale back-press requests; ignore ModernUI center hotkey while chatting.
* Stability/logging: replace `printStackTrace` with Log4j logging; remove Kiwi fatal log spam; fix mixin disable checks with multiple flags.
* Compatibility: improve ImmediatelyFast framebuffer compat; align loader metadata for known mod conflicts; add `ModListCompat` pilot and compat-layer doc.
* Misc: use `getStyleModifier` when available for rarity; remove unfinished music visualizer stubs; gate forced GC to developer mode; add missing `ru_ru` and `uk_ua` translation keys.
* Build/docs: gate `mavenLocal` behind `-PuseMavenLocal`; drop Minecraft `1.21.8` build target; add GitHub Actions CI build matrix; changelog maintenance (merge per-version entries and normalize headings).

### Modern UI for Minecraft - mVUS 3.12.0.5-build.1— 1.21.11 兼容性更新（2026-01-03）
* 将默认构建目标更新为 Minecraft 1.21.11，并在 Fabric/Forge/NeoForge 上验证 1.21.8–1.21.11
* 扩展加载器元数据版本范围以覆盖 `<1.21.12`，并更新最低加载器要求
* 为 1.21.8/1.21.9/1.21.10/1.21.11 添加 `-Pminecraft_version=...` Gradle 配置文件，并为补丁级 API 漂移添加兼容性垫片
* 针对 1.21.8 与 1.21.9+ 的包格式变更，更新 Forge/NeoForge 的 `pack.mcmeta` 架构
